faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CosmicPDF

ai.q: How does the AI-powered editing work?
ai.a: Our advanced AI technology uses machine learning to understand document structure, detect text and images, and intelligently suggest edits. It can automatically recognize forms, extract data, and help you make changes faster than traditional PDF editors.

security.q: Is my data secure and private?
security.a: We use strong encryption for data transfers and storage. Your documents are processed securely. We design CosmicPDF to meet common compliance expectations; review our Privacy Policy and your organization’s requirements before uploading sensitive data.

formats.q: What file formats do you support?
formats.a: We support PDF as the primary format, with conversion capabilities to and from Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), images (JPG, PNG), and more. You can also merge different file types into a single PDF where supported.

offline.q: Can I use this tool offline?
offline.a: The marketing site is static; the product experience is cloud-based to leverage powerful AI processing. Some workflows may offer desktop experiences—see the app for details.

trial.q: What happens after my free trial ends?
trial.a: After your trial, you can choose a paid plan or continue on a free tier where available. Your documents and work are saved according to the product’s retention rules.

enterprise.q: Do you offer team or enterprise plans?
enterprise.a: Yes. We offer team plans with shared workspaces and enterprise options with advanced security and support. Contact sales for custom pricing.

faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our company

founded.a: We were founded in 2020 with a simple mission: to make document editing as intuitive as having a conversation. Since then, we have grown to serve millions of users across many countries.

location.a: We are headquartered in San Francisco, California, with remote team members distributed across North America, Europe, and Asia.

security.q: How do you ensure data security?
security.a: Security is at the core of everything we build. We use strong encryption, follow common compliance frameworks, and design retention policies to reduce risk. Always review our Privacy Policy for details.

enterprise.a: Yes. We provide enterprise solutions with dedicated support, integrations, SSO capabilities, advanced security features, and flexible deployment options.

ai.q: What makes your AI technology different?

team.q: How can I join your team?

introduction.body: Welcome to CosmicPDF. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy describes how we handle information when you visit our marketing site and when you use the CosmicPDF product.

collected.title: Information We Collect

contact.body: email address and phone numbers where provided.

technical.label: Technical Data:

usage.label: Usage Data:

marketing.title: Marketing Site
marketing.body: This repository hosts a static marketing site. It does not execute server-side processing for uploads. Any file handoff should be implemented in the product application according to your security review.
